sentences.en: The locals around here really live at a relaxed pace.
sentences.zh: 这里的当地人生活节奏真的非常悠闲。

sentences.en: To climb steep hills requires a slow pace at first.
sentences.zh: 要爬上陡峭的山坡一开始需要慢一些的步伐。

sentences.en: You have to pace yourself or you'll choke halfway through.
sentences.zh: 你得控制好自己的速度，否则中途就会力不从心。
